one_month_reasoning: No PANW earnings fall in the window to 2026-11-05: fiscal Q1 FY27 ends Oct 31, no date has been announced, Q1 FY26 was reported Nov 19, 2025 (company release) and StockAnalysis estimates Nov 18, 2026. The date announcement itself may land inside the window but carries no price information. In-window news is read-through only (peer Q3 prints in late October, dates not confirmed by the companies) plus macro (10Y at 5.27%). The stock closed at a record $419.91 after an intraday high of $432.33, +97.5% in a year, on sector AI-security sentiment rather than new company numbers. Momentum argues mildly up, the 97x NTM multiple and the 9.3% close-to-close drop (11% intraday) on Sep 2 after a beat-and-raise argue mildly down, so I stay neutral: median ~$418. Dispersion: 1Y realized vol 47.4% gives ~13.4%/month (/3.5), 3M realized 57.7% gives ~16.5%; I use a mixture of 85% at 14% and 15% at 22% monthly log-sd for sector de-rating or AI-headline shocks. P(>= $419.91) = 0.488.

fair_value.method: Blend at Oct-2027 on consensus inputs: P/E 52x (11-peer NTM median 51.6x, no premium) x Oct-2027 NTM EPS $5.01 = $260 (45%); EV/FCF 38.72x peer median x FY27E GAAP FCF $5.01B + $6.13B net cash / 853.8M = $234 (30%); DCF (10% WACC, 4% terminal, 40% FCF margin, consensus growth) $203 (25%). 0.45 x 260.4 + 0.30 x 234.4 + 0.25 x 202.9 = $238, ~43% below $419.91.

bear.story: Full multiple normalisation: the sector AI-security premium unwinds and PANW trades at ~53x Oct-2027 NTM EPS $5.01 (the 51.6x peer median) = ~$265, close to the P/E method value. Estimates hold (FY27 guide met, FY28 ~+16%) but reported growth converges toward organic (+14.2% in Q3 FY26) once CyberArk laps in Feb 2027 and the Chronosphere LLM-migration tail ends in Q1 FY27. The fatter left tail of this component (log-sd 0.38) covers estimate cuts toward the thesis-break level.

base.story: Partial convergence: PANW meets FY27 guidance (revenue $14.10-14.20B, EPS $4.16-4.19, 38% adjusted FCF margin, NGS ARR +22-23%) and FY28 consensus (+16.5% EPS) stays intact; the multiple compresses from 97x NTM today to ~75x Oct-2027 NTM EPS $5.01 = ~$375. Earnings growth offsets most, not all, of the de-rating.

bull.story: The AI-security re-rating persists (CRWD 186x, NET 225x NTM today): NGS ARR beats the 22-23% guide, the 40% FY28 FCF target is reaffirmed early, NTM EPS trends to ~$5.10 and the stock holds ~100x = ~$510.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium or discount. In PANW's favour: FY28 consensus EPS growth +16.5% vs a peer next-FY median of +11.4%, FY28 revenue +14.5% vs +11.35%, GAAP FCF margin 35.8% vs 29.3%, net cash $6.13B and scale ($11.48B FY26 revenue). Against: consensus 3Y EPS CAGR 14.4% is below the 16.1% peer median because CyberArk was paid with 112M new shares (FY27 EPS growth only ~9%); FTNT and QLYS have higher FCF margins at far lower multiples; SBC is ~15% of revenue; organic revenue growth was +14.2% in Q3 FY26. Because the evidence points both ways, a premium cannot be argued as persistent through Oct-2027, so the median is used. The very high-multiple peers (CRWD, NET) sit on near-zero current earnings and do not set the median.

thesis_break_reason: $215 is ~43x Oct-2027 NTM consensus EPS ($5.01). At the 51.6x peer median it implies NTM EPS of only ~$4.17, i.e. no growth beyond the FY27 guide midpoint ($4.175), so a sustained move below it would mean the market is pricing estimate cuts, not just the loss of the AI-security premium (moves to $240-300 are consistent with multiple normalisation alone and with my $238 fair value). Likely causes: an NGS ARR guide cut below +22%, the 40% FY28 FCF target withdrawn, CyberArk/identity integration slippage (goodwill is $22.0B of $48.5B assets), or another exploited PAN-OS zero-day like CVE-2026-0300 hurting firewall trust. It is also well below the May-June 2026 trading lows ($243.04 on May 27, $251.15 on Jun 9).

reasoning: Round 2 changes are driven by the supervisor's fact checks, which I re-verified at primary sources. (1) Treasury: the 10Y on 2026-10-06 was 5.27% (my 5.15% was the 7Y column); the 3M was 4.21% (the supervisor's 4.13% is the 2M column). (2) Consensus: StockAnalysis shows FY27 EPS $4.19 and FY28 $4.88 (+16.48%) and FY28 revenue +14.49%, so my round-1 own path (+20% revenue, +22% EPS) is replaced by consensus; Oct-2027 NTM EPS = $5.01 (was $5.35). (3) Organic growth is now derived from the Q3 FY26 release: (3,002-388)/2,289-1 = +14.2% (the Pluang/Seeking Alpha relay is dropped). (4) The FCF-yield method mixed a market-cap yield with peers; it is replaced by EV/FCF on SA's GAAP basis for all 11 peers and PANW, applied to FY27 GAAP FCF (the trailing figure on 2027-10-06, since Q1 FY28 is reported only in Nov 2027). Here I differ from the supervisor, who applied the GAAP-basis peer multiple to adjusted FCF including a quarter of FY28 ($292); on one basis it is $234. (5) Peers: 11 security names on one calendar-weighted NTM basis using each page's this-FY and next-FY EPS (VRNS and RBRK dropped as P/E-not-meaningful; SAIL identity and FFIV application/network security added). Median 51.6x. The supervisor's FTNT 49.5x used a derived FY27 EPS of $4.00, but SA lists $3.78, giving 51.7x. Growth evidence vs peers is mixed, so 52x with no premium (supervisor 55x). Valuation: P/E $260, EV/FCF $234, DCF $203, blend $238 (was $286). Alternative-lane signals stay context only and move no number: Wikipedia pageviews (Sep 2026 16,747 vs 26,020 in Jul 2025 and 21,311 in Feb 2026) show no retail mania; hiring data show no organic surge (Unify +17.3% profiles includes acquired staff; JobzMall net -8 roles in July); insiders sell into the rally under 10b5-1, with no buying; short interest is low (2.67%). Distribution: three lognormal components, bear $265 (30%, log-sd 0.38), base $375 (45%, 0.34), bull $510 (25%, 0.36). Total log-sd ~0.43 against 47% 1Y and 58% 3M realized vol. Median ~$367, mean ~$400, P(>= $420) = 0.376. Reconciling with fair value: the ladder median sits above the $238 fair value because a 97x-to-52x de-rating rarely completes inside 12 months while the sector premium persists and momentum is strong; the bear case equals full convergence of the P/E multiple ($265), the fair value is below that because the DCF and EV/FCF methods are lower still, and P(close <= $238) = 16% in the ladder. Thesis break moves to $215 because the round-1 $255 and the supervisor's $245 are now at or above my fair value, i.e. reachable by de-rating alone. Research limits: 1 web search plus direct fetches of primary pages; Axios (403) and the round-1 Hacker News, GuruFocus, Barclays/247 Wall St, Hudson Labs, Beancount and Pluang items were dropped because they were not re-verified or were secondary. In-lane sources are ~20% of the list because the peer rule needs 22 data pages.
